name: NY-20
label: Safe D

key_factors: Tonko is a well-funded incumbent in a D+8 district
Challenger raised only ~$29k with no outside support
No polling available, so uncertainty stays elevated
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Tonko: a D+8 seat, incumbency, a large fundraising edge, and no outside spending against him, while prediction markets price a Democratic win near 95%. With no polls to refine the estimate, the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin with wide uncertainty.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending or an unexpectedly strong challenger campaign could narrow the margin, though a seat this lean rarely flips.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Paul Tonko seeks another term in a Capital Region district that leans Democratic by about eight points. He has raised nearly $1 million and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Ralph Ambrosio has raised under $30,000 and drawn no outside support. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent, and prediction markets give the Democratic side roughly a 95 percent chance of holding the seat.

With no public polling in the race, the forecast rests on district lean, incumbency, and the money gap. Those fundamentals point to a comfortable Tonko win, though the absence of polling keeps the uncertainty band wide. The seat is rated Safe Democratic.
